title: Gradient Heterogeneity Complements Hessian Heterogeneity in Transformer Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2502.00213v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformers are difficult to optimize with stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and largely rely on adaptive optimizers such as Adam. Despite extensive efforts, the mechanisms behind Adam's advantage over SGD in Transformer optimization are still not fully understood. In this study, we analyze the optimization of Transformer models in the fine-tuning setting through the lens of gradient heterogeneity, defined as the variation in gradient norms across parameter blocks. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that gradient heterogeneity, together with Hessian heterogeneity, degrades the convergence of gradient-based methods such as SGD, while sign-based methods are substantially less sensitive to this effect. Adam and SignSGD both perform coordinate-wise updates and are less sensitive to the scale of individual gradient coordinates than SGD. translated_title: 梯度异质性在Transformer优化中补充了Hessian异质性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2502.00213v5 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：Transformer模型在使用随机梯度下降（SGD）时难以优化，并且主要依赖如Adam等自适应优化器。尽管已有大量研究，但Adam在Transformer优化中优于SGD的机制仍未完全理解。在本研究中，我们通过梯度异质性的视角分析Transformer模型在微调设置中的优化，该异质性定义为各参数块间梯度范数的变化。我们提供了理论分析，表明梯度异质性连同Hessian异质性会降低基于梯度的优化方法（如SGD）的收敛性，而基于符号的方法对此效应相对不敏感。Adam和SignSGD都执行坐标级更新，对单个梯度坐标的尺度敏感性低于SGD。这促使我们使用SignSGD作为Adam类行为的可解析代理。
tldr: 本文发现梯度异质性加剧了Transformer优化难度，而基于符号的方法（如Adam和SignSGD）对此不敏感，从而解释了Adam优于SGD的原因。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that gradient heterogeneity exacerbates Transformer optimization difficulty, while sign-based methods (e.g., Adam and SignSGD) are insensitive to it, explaining Adam's advantage over SGD.
